entries.59566ed1e8dfe836: The Research & Insight Business holds Research Panel Inc., which manages registered monitors, within the group, giving it a structure that can use one of the largest survey monitor pools in Japan. User information derived from surveys amounts to 16.4 million people, and Social & Digital Promotion uses this data as a foundation for customer analysis and promotion. By holding both research and digital marketing within the group, the structure allows it to provide consistent services from research and analysis through to execution support.
